# PR comment

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Create or update a sticky PR/issue comment identified by a marker

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/pr-comment@v1
  with:
    marker: # Stable identifier for this comment. One marker per concern, per PR.
```

## How it works

Upsert a single sticky comment on a PR or issue, keyed by a hidden marker.

Every pipeline in this toolkit that wants to report back — terraform plan, LLM eval
results, cost reports, deploy previews — writes through here, so a PR ends up with one
stable comment per concern that gets edited in place instead of a wall of duplicates on
every push.

The marker is an HTML comment (`<!-- actions-toolkit:terraform-plan -->`) invisible in the
rendered comment. Body text is passed through the API, never through a shell command
line, so untrusted content can't inject.

Requires `permissions: pull-requests: write` (or `issues: write` for issues).

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `marker` | **yes** | — | Stable identifier for this comment. One marker per concern, per PR. |
| `body` | no | `""` | Markdown body. The marker is prepended automatically. |
| `body-file` | no | `""` | Read the body from this file instead of `body`. Takes precedence. |
| `issue-number` | no | `""` | PR/issue number. Empty resolves from the event payload. |
| `mode` | no | `upsert` | upsert \| append \| recreate \| delete. `recreate` deletes then posts (bumps notifications). |
| `max-length` | no | `60000` | Truncate the body to this many characters (GitHub's hard limit is 65536). |
| `github-token` | no | `${{ github.token }}` | Token with write access to pull requests/issues. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `comment-id` | The id of the comment created or updated. Empty when deleted or skipped. |
